title: Hour markers off (for finger pricks only?) by ~ 10 minutes
symptom: When syncing a Contour BG meter via BT without a CGM, a blood sample taken at 14:46 is displayed close to the 15:00 marker, off by about 10 minutes. The upper range limit line also appears shifted. The offset seems to be in the hour markers, which appear shifted to the left by ~10 minutes in both portrait and landscape modes.
cause: The marker is intentionally placed about 15 minutes in advance to account for the delay between blood and tissue glucose, even though this is not needed for finger prick measurements.
fix: No fix or workaround is provided; the behavior is intentional and there is no switch to change it.
evidence_quote: The marker is placed 15 (?) minutes in advance to take the delay between blood and tissue glucose into account. In your case this is not needed but AFAIK there is no switch to change the behaviour.
